And too those who seem to think he's another average player I hope you watch some toulouse (probably the best club in the world) highlights, and scotland six nations highlights, then you'll understand the man. results.comment: Great stuff. Could have gone either way. Australia did some great things - even in the second half - but the Lions were immense defensively. Three moments - Curry reading the play and destroying JAS from behind to win back possession when a try looked on; Keenan saving the 50:22 in the red zone with a finger tip and toe tap; Gibson Park staying afloat long enough for the cavalry to arrive, win the ruck ball and exit. I'm sure there were other big moments, but those ones stand out.
